name: productivity
description: Productivity skills. analyse-pertinence: fetch a URL's content (YouTube video or website) via Apify, then judge whether it's relevant for Romain (growth/outbound profile) and how to reuse it; needs APIFY_TOKEN. grill-me: stress-test a plan via relentless interview. handoff: compact a conversation into a handoff doc. write-a-skill: author new skills. write-like-me: rewrite in the user's voice (no AI tells). malt-response: Malt proposal playbook. malt-workflow: end-to-end Malt offer handling (Gmail intake, fit, reply + reinforcement email, or off-target ranking dossier) plus a profile-audit mode. brainstorm: structured brainstorm (grill-me interrogation + superpowers design flow) turning a fuzzy idea into a validated design or action plan. i-have-adhd: output shaped for an ADHD reader (next action first, numbered steps, state restated every turn, time estimates in minutes, visible wins), manual /i-have-adhd, stays on until "stop adhd mode"; from ayghri/i-have-adhd (MIT).
